title: California Governor Vetoes Bill Setting Spending Rules for $5B Plastic Pollution Fund
detail: California Governor Gavin Newsom vetoed SB 1180 on September 20, 2026, a bill by state Sen. Ben Allen that would have set binding spending rules for the state's Plastic Pollution Mitigation Fund — created under the SB 54 packaging extended-producer-responsibility law and projected to collect roughly $5 billion in producer fees over the next decade. SB 1180 would have directed 60% of collected fees toward monitoring and reducing plastic pollution's environmental-justice and public-health impacts on overburdened communities, and 40% toward broader environmental impacts on human health and terrestrial, aquatic and marine life. In his veto message, Newsom said the administration's ongoing work to route funding to appropriate entities was already underway and that the bill 'risks complicating implementation' of both SB 54 and the fund. The bill was backed by Greenpeace USA and Ocean Conservancy and opposed by the American Chemistry Council, Plastics Industry Association, Flexible Packaging Association and Foodservice Packaging Institute.

media.caption: Gov. Gavin Newsom vetoes SB 1180, which would have set spending rules for California's plastic pollution fund

title: Canadian and U.S. Crews Free Entangled Humpback Whale Calf in Cross-Border Rescue
detail: A humpback whale calf trailing more than 300 feet of rope and a buoy was first spotted traveling with its mother off the west coast of Vancouver Island on Friday, September 18, 2026, by the crew of the Canadian Coast Guard Ship John P. Tully. Fisheries and Oceans Canada's Marine Mammal Rescue Unit, led by Paul Cottrell, tracked the pair with support from fishery officers and the CCGS M. Charles, attaching a satellite tag to the trailing gear so the entangled calf could be followed as it crossed into U.S. waters, where the U.S.-based NOAA Fisheries West Coast Rescue Team joined the effort. After a two-day operation, Cottrell made a final cut with a pole knife on Sunday, September 20, freeing the whale of the remaining gear. It was the second cross-border entanglement rescue involving Canadian and American crews in as many months.

media.caption: DFO and NOAA crews free an entangled humpback whale calf in a cross-border rescue near the Juan de Fuca Strait
